format: Each case: the kind of the chat described by evidence = expect, a ChatKind. evidence: id (review_sessions.id); kind (the generation-1 kind column: chat, review, memory, or absent before schema 89); isTeamSnapshot (team_id set); isNamedByWalkthroughProgress (a walk's progress_json.chat_session_id names it); holdsWalkthroughStep (an exchange carries a WalkthroughStepTurn step line); hasOverallScore; hasCardIDs; hasGradedExchange (an exchange with a score or an idea coverage); every flag absent means false. The first rule that holds: (1) isTeamSnapshot -> transcript; (2) kind memory, or the id starts memory- or mcp-memory-review- -> memory; (3) the id starts course-quiz- -> quizSitting; (4) the id contains -live- -> voice; (5) isNamedByWalkthroughProgress or holdsWalkthroughStep -> walkthrough; (6) kind review, hasOverallScore, hasCardIDs or hasGradedExchange -> review; (7) chat. Prefixes and markers match exactly (letter case included).
status: Written with WP2 from the production chat shapes of §10; built by scripts/schema/build-vectors.mjs from its reference classifier.

cases.name: a chat recorded before kinds, with nothing else to tell: chat
generation-1 kind chat stays chat
generation-1 kind review is review
generation-1 kind memory is memory
production shape: a NULL-kind ios-live- session is voice
production shape: a mac-live- session is voice
production shape: a carplay-live- session is voice
production shape: a course-quiz- sitting is quizSitting
production shape: a walkthrough chat named by a walk's progress
production shape: a walkthrough chat holding a step line
production shape: a scored review recorded before kinds
production shape: an mcp-memory-review-operation- chat is memory
production shape: an mcp-memory-review- daily review is memory
production shape: a memory- review is memory
production shape: a team snapshot is a transcript, scores already stripped
a chat holding card ids is a review
a chat with a graded exchange (a score or an idea coverage) is a review
rule order: a team snapshot of a memory review is still a transcript
rule order: a team snapshot that held a step line is still a transcript
rule order: memory before a live id (memory- prefix wins over -live-)
rule order: memory before a quiz (kind memory on a course-quiz- id)
rule order: a course-quiz- sitting with a score is quizSitting, not review
rule order: a course-quiz- id containing -live- is quizSitting
rule order: a live session that played a walkthrough step is voice
rule order: a walkthrough chat with a score is walkthrough, not review
rule order: kind review that holds a step line is walkthrough
rule order: kind chat with a score is review (the first rule that holds decides)
ids are matched by their prefixes exactly: a memory word elsewhere is no memory id
ids are matched exactly: live without the dashes on both sides is no voice id
ids are matched exactly: an uppercase prefix is no quiz id
ids are matched exactly: memory without its dash is no memory id
a generation-1 kind this build does not know falls through the rules
